scope: Sign-in settings for one environment on a clean GitHub runner, not a real server: a site URL, redirect addresses and a GitHub provider with a placeholder client saved through the management API and applied by recreating that environment's Auth; a keyless OAuth start and email link through the gateway as a browser sends them; the provider removed again. No real provider was contacted. Transcribed from the CI docker-install job 107483836458 (run 35952386382, commit 5607847).

checks.check: a publishable key is issued for the check
an environment starts with the default sign-in settings
an unsafe site URL is refused
an owner saves a site URL, redirects and GitHub
the provider secret is never sent back
the supervisor recreates Auth with the settings
a browser starts a GitHub sign-in without a key
GitHub is told this environment's callback address
an email link reaches Auth without a key and returns to the application
email sign-up still works after the recreate
GitHub sign-in is gone once applied
